en.t: After dusk, they arrived at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 她从来不曾见过这等壮丽的宫殿，但觉神移目眩。

en.t: She had never seen such a magnificent palace before, and felt utterly dazzled in both mind and eye.

units.source_text: 车辆进入“三轩四轩”之中，匂亲王已经等得不耐烦，亲自走近车旁，扶二女公子下车。

en.t: When the carriage entered the area of the three or four bays, Prince Niou, already impatient from waiting, came personally to the carriage and helped the Second Princess down.

units.source_text: 殿内装饰焕然一新，设备应有尽有。

en.t: Inside the palace, the decorations were completely renewed, and every necessary furnishing was in place.

units.source_text: 连众侍女的房室，也显然是由匂亲王自己用心布置的，真可谓尽善尽美了。

en.t: Even the rooms for the waiting women had clearly been arranged with care by Prince Niou himself, and could truly be called flawless.

units.source_text: 世人起初不知道匂亲王对二女公子待遇厚薄如何，忽然看见如此排场，方知其爱情实在不浅。

en.t: At first people did not know how generously Prince Niou would treat the Second Princess, but when they suddenly saw such splendor, they understood that his love was indeed deep.

units.source_text: 大家不胜惊叹，羡慕二女公子纳福。

en.t: Everyone was endlessly amazed and envied the good fortune that had come to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言定于本月二十日过后迁居新建的三条宫邸，近来天天在那里察看工事。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had decided to move after the twentieth of this month into his newly built Sanjo residence, and lately he went there every day to inspect the work.

units.source_text: 三条宫邸离二条院甚近。

en.t: The Sanjo residence was very close to Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言欲知二女公子迁居情况，这一天就在三条宫邸住到夜深。

en.t: Wanting to know how the Second Princess's move was going, Kaoru stayed at the Sanjo residence until late that night.

units.source_text: 派赴宇治参加行列的人员回来了，向他禀告情况。

en.t: The people who had been sent to Uji to join the procession returned and reported the situation to him.

units.source_text: 他闻知匂亲王非常怜爱二女公子，一面感到欢喜，一面又痛惜自己错过机会，胸中悲伤不堪。

en.t: When he heard that Prince Niou cherished the Second Princess greatly, he felt glad, yet at the same time bitterly regretted having missed his own chance, and his heart was unbearably sorrowful.

units.source_text: 只得独自反复吟咏“但愿流光能倒退”的古歌。

en.t: He could only sit alone, repeatedly murmuring the old poem, If only the flowing light of time could turn back.
He also recited a poem, saying:
